title: Isolation of human bone marrow stromal cells from bone marrow biopsies for single-cell RNA sequencing
protocol: Clean a biohazard safety cabinet or sterile working area with 70% ethanol.
Clean pipettes and tweezers with 70% ethanol.
Allow the cleaned mortar and pestle to air dry for approximately 5 minutes in a sterile biohazard safety cabinet.
Rinse the mortar and pestle with sterile PBS just prior to use.
Flush the BM biopsy with 1 mL Cell Isolation buffer using a P1000 pipette tip or insulin syringe.
Place the BM biopsy in a clean mortar with 5 mL Cell Isolation buffer (2% FBS/PBS).
Gently crush the BM biopsy using the pestle, tapping directly onto the bone fragments.
Transfer crushed cells to a 70 μm cell strainer and collect with the flushed fraction.
Transfer remaining crushed bone fragments to a new 50 mL falcon tube.
Digest the remaining crushed bone fragments with Collagenase II enzyme.
Place a 70 μm cell strainer over a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Carefully flush the BM biopsy with 1 mL Cell Isolation buffer through the cell strainer into the 50 mL Falcon tube.
Repeat flushing step twice.
Avoid brisk movements during cell handling to maximize the number of cells available for analysis downstream.
Transfer approximately 5 mL of buffer from the mortar through the cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube used in step 4 [Flush/Crush Fraction].
Centrifuge the Flush/Crush Fraction tube at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet gently in 300 μl of Cell Isolation buffer to prevent clumping.
Transfer remaining bone fragments (bone chips) from the mortar into a second sterile 50 mL Falcon tube [Bone Chip Fraction].
Rinse the mortar and the cell strainer used in steps 4 and 7 with prepared 10 mL Collagenase II solution and combine with Bone Chip Fraction tube.
Seal the Bone Chip Fraction 50 mL Tube containing bone chips and Collagenase II solution with Parafilm.
Place the sealed tube in a pre-warmed, shaking incubator.
Incubate the Bone Chip Fraction tube for 90 min at 37°C under gentle agitation.
After digestion, let the bone chips settle to the bottom of the 50 mL falcon.
Carefully transfer supernatant through a 70 μm cell strainer into a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Wash the digested bone chips with 10 mL Cell Isolation buffer.
Combine supernatant with the new tube used in step 14.
Repeat this washing and transferring step.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Centrifuge the combined cell suspensions in a 50 mL Falcon tube at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and gently resuspend the cell pellet in 110 μL Cell Isolation buffer.
Aliquot 10 μL of cell suspension into a separate 1.5 mL eppendorf.
Add 290 μL of Cell Isolation buffer to the aliquot for unstained and single stain samples.
Add 5 μL of the antibody mastermix to the remaining 100 μL cell suspension.
Mix gently.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash the cell suspension with 1 mL Cell Isolation buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 300 μL Cell Isolation buffer.
Pass the sample through a 5 mL Falcon® Round-Bottom Tube with Cell Strainer Cap (35 μm nylon mesh).
Keep samples at 4°C in the dark.
Prepare 1.5 mL eppendorfs with 300 μL Sorting buffer (DMEM/10% FBS).
Store on ice until use.
Add 3 μL of 7-AAD solution (1:100 dilution) to the cell suspension just prior to cell sorting.
Use aliquots of single-stained cells for voltage settings, area scaling, and setting sort gates.
Add 7-AAD solution just prior to FACS to prevent overstaining.
Discard doublets using FSC-H and FSC-W parameters.
Discard non-viable cells using the PerCp-Cy5.5 channel.
Sort CD45- CD235a- CD71- CD41- CD61- cells (FITC channel) according to the gating strategy.
Sort desired cell populations into 300 μL sorting buffer in prepared 1.5 mL eppendorfs.
Transfer sorted samples onto ice.
Centrifuge collected cells at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant until approximately 40 μL remains, then resuspend the cell pellet.
Proceed with the single-cell RNA sequencing pipeline.
